layers.name: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
layers.description: Monthly median NDVI of cloud-free Landsat scenes, averaged over the parcel.
layers.honesty: Painted as one value for the whole parcel: the analysis stores the parcel mean, not a 30 m map (30 m tiles are a P1 item).

layers.name: Root-zone soil moisture (SMAP L4)
layers.description: Monthly mean of SMAP L4 sm_rootzone (0-100 cm) in the grid cell that contains the parcel.
layers.honesty: The whole SMAP grid cell is drawn as one polygon: the value describes a ~9-11 km zone, never a point.

layers.name: Monthly rainfall (NASA POWER)
layers.description: Monthly total of PRECTOTCORR for the MERRA-2 cell of the parcel.
layers.honesty: The MERRA-2 cell is drawn as one polygon with its monthly total; no tiles, no interpolation.

layers.name: Slope (NASADEM)
layers.description: Terrain slope from NASADEM, computed on the unclipped DEM and shown per pixel inside the parcel.
layers.honesty: Native 1 arc-second pixels, nearest-neighbour, no smoothing. Radar DEM from 2000: field levelling since then is not captured.

layers.name: Risk zones (scenario)
layers.description: Erosion screening per pixel (slope varies per pixel; rain, soil and cover are parcel/zone factors) and possible cold-air pooling (hollows with low slope).

source.name: Derived from NASADEM + NASA POWER + OpenLandMap + Landsat

layers.honesty: Relative screening index; not a soil-loss estimate. Cold-air pooling is a team screening rule (TPI ≤ -1 m, slope ≤ 2°), not a validated model.
